metadata.title: Robinhood CEO Sees Prediction Markets as Fastest Growing Business

content.text:
Robinhood Chairman and CEO Vlad Tenev says the prediction markets business is the fastest growing in the firm's history. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Tenev also discusses the company's initiatives, Trump Accounts and the future of crypto.
